sum_insured_options: ₹5L – ₹20L (based on deductible table; exact SI range not fully stated)

room_rent.note: Standard A/C room (single occupancy with attached washroom, excluding suite). Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

icu.note: ICU expenses paid at actuals as per policy wording.

copayment.display: None (base); 20% if reimbursement under Cashless Discount add-on
copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Voluntary co-pay of 5%/10%/15%/20% available for premium discount. If Cashless Discount optional cover is opted, 20% co-pay applies on reimbursement claims.

sub_limits.note: Inbuilt cataract sub-limit: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹50,000. Optional 'Procedure/Disease Sublimit' cover adds caps on cardiac, joints, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, gall bladder, spine, cancer, CKD, CLD etc.

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹10,000 to ₹3,00,000 available as optional discount feature.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: 36 months continuous coverage required. Reducible via portability credit from prior insurer.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, calculi, hysterectomy, organ transplant, joint arthroplasty, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded (Code Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year, max 100%. Reduces at same rate on claim. Optional 'Super Cumulative Bonus' add-on offers up to 200% at 25%/yr.

restoration.note: Sum Insured Reinstatement is an optional cover. Options: once per policy year or unlimited times per policy year. Not available for organ donor or modern treatment claims. Subsequent hospitalisation must be after 2-day gap.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Extensive indicative list of 399+ procedures provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available, must exceed 3 days. Several conditions excluded: asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, vector-borne diseases, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation (min 24 hrs) covered up to In-patient SI. Out-patient and comfort/leisure treatments excluded.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses for organ donor covered up to SI when insured is the recipient. Pre/post-hospitalisation for donor not covered. Restoration benefit not applicable.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to In-patient Hospitalisation SI for emergency transfer and inter-hospital transfer.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, stem cell for haematological conditions, etc.) covered up to SI. Restoration and CB not applicable for this cover.

consumables.note: Standard non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are excluded. No optional consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Policy covers treatment within India only. Any treatment outside India is explicitly excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for established fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: 30 days for all modes except monthly premium where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period at inception only; not applicable at renewal or porting.

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, maternity excluded, domiciliary excludes diabetes/hypertension/asthma etc., no consumables cover, terrorism covered

optional_riders.display: Sum Insured Reinstatement (once/unlimited), Super Cumulative Bonus (up to 200%), Disease Sublimits, Cashless Discount, Accidental Death Cover, No Claim Discount, Voluntary Co-pay/Deductible
